summary: A type selector sits in the header before Review and defaults to Ask editor agent. Review follows that plan: agent or Simple generate, otherwise start read-only or rebase. Working-tree rebase is omitted and coerced. Tests, manifest ids, and this sidecar are skipped.

README.md.rationale: Walk step 3 restates the selector for users

test/unit/home-setup.test.ts.rationale: Planner cases for the rules you walk

.tabthrough.home-review-type.guide.json.rationale: This walk, written into the tree it describes

steps.title: Agent is the default review type
steps.rationale: The type every later selector and Review click consults

steps.title: Review plans from that type
steps.rationale: First consumer — generate versus start, with working-tree rebase coerced
steps.notes: Working-tree Review maps rebase to readonly. The dropdown can omit the option; a leftover kind still cannot start a rebase.

steps.title: Type labels, no rebase on working tree
steps.rationale: The option list the header select will show
steps.notes: The labels are the old generate-screen rows. Rebase stays off working changes because there is no commit to stop on.

steps.title: Selector sits before Review
steps.rationale: First consumer of those labels — nav slot, immediately before the primary

steps.title: Same header row as Review
steps.rationale: Back in the HTML, now the compact row the nav item asked for
steps.notes: header-kind clips the Type label so the native select can sit beside Review. :has drops the old margin-left: auto that shoved the button to the far edge.

steps.title: Review runs the plan
steps.rationale: The Review click follows the plan, agent first
steps.notes: Ask editor agent and Generate Simple guide return without startSession. Read-only and Rebase still start, with the planned sessionMode.
